_: Типы проектов, под которые я хорошо ложусь. Пока авторские (source: manual) — это первая версия того самого переключателя типов. Показываются в хиро справа от имени. Поле lens связывает тип проекта с упаковкой из packagings.json: выбор типа применяет её роль, тезис, лид и подборку кейсов. Второго механизма переключения нет.
label: Where I fit

fits.label: LLM product, zero to first paying client
fits.line: Small team, no ML department, a domain nobody in the room has worked in. Architecture, retrieval, tests and the cost model are one job here, not four.

fits.label: A prototype that demos well and breaks on real users
fits.line: The fix is rarely more content. It is a rig that tells you whether yesterday's change made things better, and a domain model that matches how the conversation actually goes.

fits.label: Analysis in someone else's domain that will be argued with
fits.line: Numbers that have to hold up when the other side is paid to break them. Sixteen years of that, and the same discipline is what evals are.
